gotchas: Guest checkout, no login needed. Open the property page directly (/hotel/<cc>/<slug>.html?checkin=YYYY-MM-DD&checkout=YYYY-MM-DD&group_adults=1&no_rooms=1&selected_currency=USD&lang=en-us): on the search results a sign-in modal ([data-bui-trap-root]) intercepts clicks on 'See availability', which also opens a new tab.

Room table: set the first select[name^=nr_rooms_] to '1', then 'I'll reserve'. Four steps follow on secure.booking.com: Your Details (button[name=book] labelled 'Next') -> Protection ('Add Travel Protection?' radios, Yes $7 vs 'No thanks'; pick No thanks, then 'Next: Final details') -> Finish booking.

On Your Details each name/email input exists twice (one hidden), hence the '>> visible=true'. Country/Region defaults to United States, so no select fill is needed there; on a not-yet-approved host make the first saved-details fill a text field.

The card form is a hosted iframe, iframe[src*=paymentcomponent.booking.com] (the cardFrame override), that loads a few seconds after the Finish booking page (a progressbar shows meanwhile). Pass it as `frame` for every card field. Inside it, 'New card' is preselected; cardholder name, number, MM/YY expiry and CVC all carry standard autocomplete attributes. The CVC is REQUIRED on the prepaid rate.

The cheapest rates are often prepaid and non-refundable ('Today you'll pay $X'; the cancel cost equals the total). A $50 refundable damage deposit is listed separately. Final button: 'Complete booking'.
Two marketing-consent checkboxes (email, SMS) sit above Complete booking, unchecked by default.

After any token fill the page's text matchers and snapshot become unavailable, and the Protection step's controls are hard to tell apart blind; take the snapshot of each step before the first fill if the flow is new.
Total: 'Today you'll pay US$X' under 'Your payment details'; no stable id/class found for an order.total hint (generated classes).
Identity-token fills on this host hold for the owner's approval of saved details; an unapproved fill was denied after ~4 min and the proxy connection dropped once during it.

Your Details submit: click button[name="book"] >> visible=true. Do NOT match the button by its 'Next' / 'Next step' text: that hits a different element, the click fires and the form never advances to Protection, which looks like a blocked required field but is not.

Phone: fill the identity's phone_national token into input[name="phoneNumber"]. The country-code dropdown beside it already shows United States +1, so the whole-number phone token does not fit the field.

The two radio groups on Your Details ('Who are you booking for?', 'Are you traveling for work?') are optional and preselected, and the add-on checkboxes (paperless confirmation, flights, car, taxi, crib) are optional: none of them block the Your Details submit.
Protection step selectors that work blind after a token fill: label:has-text("No thanks"), then button:has-text("Final details") >> visible=true.

No address is asked of a US guest: the page's address/city/zip inputs are present but hidden on every step, and the payment iframe has no billing-address or postcode field. There is nowhere to put address tokens.

One fill_checkout into the card frame in this order works: cc-name (identity full_name token), cc-exp as MM/YY, cc-number, cc-csc immediately after. wait_for_selector on cc-number with the frame first, since the iframe mounts late. The card fill went through without an order.total hint.
observe_page comes back inconclusive on the Finish booking page (cross-origin payment frame), so it cannot confirm the card fields were accepted.

route.note: Pick dates in the query (checkin/checkout/group_adults=1/no_rooms=1), set the first select[name^=nr_rooms_] to 1, click I'll reserve; on secure.booking.com fill the guest contact form, Next step, choose Don't add insurance, Next: Final details. The payment iframe loads a few seconds later.
